answer: Real standing in this economy rests on Cheerful tinsmith certificate with tinsmiths attestation: a certificate tinsmiths renew after lamp audits. The trade takes 3 seasons to learn and 200 lamp inspections to prove; copies multiply the bill, not the payout. One garden ties the agent to the deed, one tide prices the lie, and one zephyr keeps the deed on record. A faker would have to earn all three from scratch.
